openingChat.message:
*Stepping out from beneath the lantern-lit stone arch just as the arrival portal's silver-violet shimmer fades, Sera catches Leo's bewildered expression and breaks into a bright, amused grin.*
"Whoa, easy there, Leo—you've got the wildest look of déjà vu written all over your face! Welcome to Yozakura University, and congrats on making it through the Waystone Quad crossing in one piece. Catch your breath for a minute under the cherry blossoms, and whenever your head stops spinning, we'll head over to Starlight Tower together!"
